$comment: Markers declared BEFORE the draws that use them. v3.4.0 recorded a case whose markers no longer described its file and stated that the fix was to declare a new list before the next run rather than after reading a result. This file is that promise made checkable: tests/../tools/eval-corpus/run.mjs fails when a case's markers in cases.json differ from the list declared here, so a marker cannot be edited to suit an outcome without the diff showing it. Its git commit is the timestamp, and it lands before the commit carrying the results.
method: Markers are written by reading the reference file and asking what a capable model would NOT reach for unprompted. That is the designer bias the harness already states and blinding does not remove it. Each entry carries a falsifiable prediction so the record shows whether the design held, not only whether the file won.

clarify-confusing-copy.why_redeclared: The previous list (pass, voice, back, help text) was single words that matched by accident: a judge counted the control's grammatical 'voix active' against the marker 'voice', which is brand voice. It also described the file as it stood before 2026-08-06. Both faults are fixed by naming each claim in full.
markers: named editing passes in a fixed order, clarity then voice then so-what then prove-it then specificity then emotion then risk
return to the earlier passes after each one, because specificity added late breaks the voice set earlier
help text must add what the label cannot say, and restating the label in a tooltip trains readers to skip every tooltip
establish the audience and the reader's mental state before rewriting anything
clarify-confusing-copy.prediction: The corpus hits 3 or 4 and the control hits 0 or 1. The operational half is now in both arms, so the file has to win on the doctrine or it wins on nothing.

markers: the AI Overviews coverage figure is a spread from roughly 9.5 to 60 percent depending on the sample, so any single number is wrong
the +527 percent AI traffic growth is Previsible and not SparkToro, and it is off a base of about 17,000 sessions
4.4x as valuable is modelled value and not a 4.4x conversion rate
brand mentions against backlinks is a correlation whose own author warns against reading causally
geo-worth-it.prediction: The control produces confident single figures it cannot source. The corpus hits 2 or more; the control hits 0.

markers: a numbered go/no-go check that refuses parallax outright when a row fails, including product UIs which never get it
the scale compensation formula for a translateZ layer, 1 plus the absolute translateZ over the perspective
the reduced-motion override must kill animation, transform and opacity together or the layer stays stuck on its first keyframe
smooth scrolling stays off on touch, smoothTouch false
parallax-hero.prediction: The control produces transform-only, will-change and prefers-reduced-motion. The corpus hits 2 or more; the control hits at most 1, and never the refusal table.

markers: a numeric score from 100 down with a fixed penalty per pattern and a cap per pattern
the long dash is judged by density against word count, around one per 200 words, and not by presence
each pattern ships a greppable regular expression rather than a description
a before and after rewrite for each pattern rather than a prohibition
slop-detection.prediction: The control lists tells and bans them. The corpus hits 2 or more; the control hits 0 or 1 and produces no scoring system.

markers: numbered thresholds for a priority URL, 1 percent of organic traffic and 10 referring domains, stated as dials to set against the size of the site
an expected traffic loss and a recovery window per migration type, for instance 20 to 40 percent over 2 to 12 weeks for a URL structure change
where no equivalent page exists, a real 404 rather than a redirect to the homepage, which is a soft 404
measure at T+1, T+7 and T+30 against a baseline captured before the move
domain-migration.prediction: The control produces 301 maps, sitemap updates and Search Console monitoring. The corpus hits 2 or more; the control hits at most 1.

markers: return tags: every page in the set links to all the others including itself, or the set is ignored
each page must be self-canonical, and canonicalising to the default language makes Google index only that one
the region subtag is uppercase, so en-uk is invalid and en-GB is correct
every URL referenced in an hreflang annotation must return 200 or it is ignored
hreflang-three-languages.prediction: This is the narrowest of the five. The control knows hreflang and x-default and may well produce return tags on its own. The corpus hits 3 or more; the control hits 1 or 2, and the self-canonical trap is the one only the file gives.
